name: ARCHEMARA [EARLY ACCESS]
desc:
Archemara is a combat-intensive co-op PVE dungeon crawler.

Archemara is currently in Early Access, your patience with any encountered bug or inconvenience is greatly appreciated!

MAIN CONTROLS
X - Draw & holster
F - Healing flask
Tab - Index Menu & close menus
M1 - Primary moveset
M1 + Shift - Secondary moveset
M1 + Ctrl - Tertiary moveset
M2 - Block & Parry
MMB - Target lock-on
Space - Dodge

All roadmaps, patch notes, & discussions are held in the Battle Core Games server.
Our community: https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32941830

Developed under Battle Core Games Ltd. Co.
Inspired by Davidii's Heroes!, Dark Souls 3, Monster Hunter & Warframe.

Many things to come.
